specs.display_type: PureSight Pro 2.8K IPS LCD, 120Hz, 500 nits, 16:10 (optional touch)

price.notes: PDP ld+json price hidden (0) but InStock; single CPU/RAM/storage tier listed (VERIFIED: Ultra 7 258V / 32GB / 1TB). Estimated from typical CA Lunar Lake pricing; heavily discounted in late 2026 as Gen 11 lines replace it — notable value pick.

offers.name: Lenovo Yoga Slim 7i Ultra Aura Edition Laptop, 14" Glass, Intel Core Ultra 7 355, 32GB, 1TB SSD

reviews.outlet: The Tech Chap (via lenovo.com/ca, sibling Slim 7a)
reviews.quote: We also have one of the absolute best displays on any laptop that I've tested.

praises: Lunar Lake 258V sips power — easily the best battery of any x86 Yoga Slim
2.8K 120Hz 500-nit IPS panel is bright and colour-accurate without OLED PWM concerns
32GB on-package memory standard — no upsell trap
Arc 140V plays popular titles at 1080p medium, unusual for a thin 15-inch iGPU machine
Quiet thermals; fan is a whisper in office work
complaints: 8-core CPU falls behind Snapdragon X2 Elite and Arrow Lake-H in heavy multitasking/compile work
IPS backlight shows corner bleed in dark rooms vs OLED siblings
Gen 9 is the outgoing generation — clearance stock and short remaining support window
Plastic-reinforced lid feels less premium than the Pro line's full aluminium
No SD reader; 15-inch size undercuts its own portability claim vs the 14-inch Slim 7x

design_philosophy: The Intel-Lunar Lake counterpart to the Slim 7x: a big-screen, big-battery x86 thin-and-light with the PureSight Pro IPS display, aimed at users who want Windows-x86 compatibility with near-ARM battery life. In late 2026 it is the value pick of the Yoga clamshell range.
rating_notes: No direct pro review fetched for this exact CA config (quote from sibling Slim 7a carousel VERIFIED via lenovo.com/ca).
